prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent inventory item icon for a premium fantasy collectible-card RPG.
Create ONE polished SSS MERCENARY CARD SHARD resource, centered on a square 1024x1024 genuinely transparent RGBA canvas.

The object is recognizably a LARGE BROKEN FRAGMENT OF A RARE COLLECTIBLE CARD, not a whole card, crystal, ticket or puzzle piece. Show approximately the upper two-thirds of a handsome portrait card, with a dramatic irregular diagonal fractured lower edge and a missing lower corner. A couple of tiny matching card splinters float close to the break; everything reads as one compact item icon. The card is slightly tilted and shown in a subtle three-quarter view so its gold-metal thickness and broken laminated edges are visible. Keep the main object large and legible at 64-128 pixels.

Visual identity: SSS rarity in this game uses luminous rose-crimson (#FF7187), deep burgundy (#5E1828), dark near-black enamel, antique gold and fine warm silver highlights. A luxurious sculpted golden card border with beautifully engraved corner flourishes surrounds the intact top and side edges. Dark ruby enamel with a subtle red crystalline sheen forms the face. A small, elegant embossed closed-helmet-and-crossed-blades mercenary crest is integrated into the central card surface as a metal insignia, not a character portrait. This is a GENERIC SSS mercenary resource; do not depict a particular existing character.
Put exactly the three letters "SSS" prominently across the upper face in bold, beautifully embossed pale-gold lettering, crisp and easy to read, with a restrained rose-lit bevel. Only those three letters appear. Keep the rank letters intact and visually dominant.
At the jagged broken edge, reveal luminous crimson/rose energy seams and a few restrained gold sparks. The broken silhouette and exposed edge must immediately communicate a collectible card FRAGMENT. Rich layered metal ornament, convincing depth, dark recesses, precise sharp bevels and premium hand-painted game-item rendering. Excellent material separation; glamorous and powerful without a noisy explosion.

Composition: one item cluster centered, occupying about 78-84 percent of the square canvas, with at least 8 percent fully transparent clearance on all sides including glow and splinters. No cropping. Glows stay tight to the physical shard and retain semitransparent alpha. The object itself is solid and opaque. Keep a clean readable silhouette.
Background: ACTUAL TRANSPARENCY everywhere outside the object. No background color, black square, white square, checkerboard pattern, ground, pedestal, backdrop, scene, character, UI panel, inventory slot border, frame around the entire canvas, shadow rectangle or vignette. No captions, numerals, quantity, names, watermark, logo, or lettering other than exactly "SSS". No multiple variants or sheet.
